purpose: Four complete integer-student routes including shared-partial-sum reconstruction, with common exact ROM encoding and separate seven-bank layout/arithmetic sensitivity
scope: Same two K8 students, existing20 full-P captures; no RTL, EDA or new training
single_port_point: 96 shared MAC/add lanes;96 lane RFs each1R1W, with7 address slots per p; one96-element state update per issue
seven_bank_point: Seven independent slot banks, each96 lanes with1R1W;96 shared MAC/add lanes plus576 additional Acc24 add lanes. At FC1 issue, each bank chooses its own p from the same source-column mask and receives the common W vector. Coefficient memory stays8x128-bit. PSN remains96 MAC lanes. Same raw state capacity does not imply same area or frequency.

restoration.latencies: synchronous vector read1; register/bypass add1 with writeback forwarding. The existing FC1 latency2 comprises read plus add. Read and write can coincide on1R1W.
restoration.zero_handling: Absent S reads supply constant zero; all-zero output writes are suppressed and validity updated. An all-zero p skips restoration and emits the precomputed original-tau gate template.
restoration.original_tau: unchanged, including offsets associated with t8/t9 before their Yi rows became zero

optimistic_bound: Grant all restoration operations/reads/writes as perfectly hidden before traditional folded PSN consumption. This is an optimistic bound, not a demonstrated schedule; it covers stronger read/copy overlap, PSN tails, and use of spare FTP adders. Do not call it measured throughput.
pipeline_record_note: Explicit common allocation for operand24, coefficient16, product40 and accumulator48 per lane per stage. This conservative architectural data allocation is not standard-cell area.
port_limitations: Seven independent bank updates require seven address/priority engines, write paths, and672 source add lanes. Giving only folded time rows that parallelism is unfair. Overlapping restore with PSN additionally needs arbitration and bank-to-work-register routing; the zero-overhead restore case is therefore only a bound here. No fabricated equal-area claim.
admission: Use B versus the complete S+restoreY+foldedA prior as the incremental comparison. Show both a feasible8-beat in-place restoration and a deliberately optimistic fully-hidden restoration bound. Seven-bank layouts and672 source add lanes are a separate resource sensitivity, not equal-area claims.
boundary: Source PSN gates for raw t0..7 are ready. Encoder then FC1/S formation then full T10 destination PSN and original tau, producing theta-g. Raw t8/t9 are irrelevant to exact nearest-code choice; source-PSN production remains outside every route.

common_encoder.input_index: all raw gates t0..7, including both t1 and t4
common_encoder.omitted_bits: t8/t9 contribute the same Hamming term to every code, so they cannot change argmin
common_encoder.tie_rule: lowest code index, checked for all1024 raw ten-bit words
common_encoder.raw_packet_payload: 96B raw eight-time decisions plus8B theta/context, padded128B
common_encoder.raw_values_limit: Raw signatures were not stored; timing charges every lookup, numerical encoder equivalence is exhaustive over possible raw words.

compact_source_buffers.write: Six3-bit code entries per beat in the fill buffer; one position is completed every16 beats.
compact_source_buffers.read: One column of32 codes =96bits per beat in the other buffer, with32 parallel code-to-time decoders and32 simple3-to8 onehot decoders. Decode is ready before the coefficient vector returns at t+2.
compact_source_buffers.organization: Register arrays indexed by position with six channel subbanks per row. Different fill/consume copies avoid simultaneous writes to a compute array. These are explicit ports, not mapped SRAM macros.
compact_source_buffers.decoder_note: 32 copies of8x10bit code-to-time truth. The code-class route uses a3-to8 onehot decode; all routes are granted both decoding functions.
compact_source_buffers.metadata: Nonempty column flags accumulated during code writes. Four prefetched320bit masks and one active320bit mask stay in the common allocation.
compact_source_buffers.no_hidden_expansion: No time-row masks are serially written by the encoder; masks are generated from a column read when its W vector is requested.

seven_bank_layouts.selection: One of the two static layouts selected for each entire student/route from aggregate ten-frame service; no per-source or per-frame free switching. This is post-hoc layout sensitivity.
seven_bank_layouts.scheduling: For each source c, all consumers are distributed to physical banks. Each bank updates one independently selected address per beat, so source issue rounds are max over bank occupancies. W is common broadcast. Seven pending32-bit consumer masks fit within the common320-bit active mask.
seven_bank_layouts.limits: Priority selection, row/slot decoding and bank routing are assumed to meet one-beat issue; no placement/frequency proof. This comparison is stronger than slot-only FTP but is not a globally optimal scheduling claim.

comparison_datapath: 96 common threshold comparators and a128-byte output packet path are included in all modes. U comparisons may overlap the final PSN MAC tail as in the original service model.
